AU.name: Australia

evidence.quote: Your photos must be: 35–40 mm wide 45–50 mm high.
The height of your face, from your chin to your crown, must be 32–36 mm.
a plain white or light grey background that contrasts with your face
You must not wear glasses in a passport photo unless you can't remove them for medical reasons.
While professional passport photo providers are recommended, all photos must still meet our passport photo guidelines.
When you apply for a passport, you'll need to include 2 good-quality photos that meet all of the requirements on this page.

AU.open_questions: The passports.gov.au online-renewal page returned 'Access denied', so whether a fully online renewal still exists (and needs a provider photo code) was not checked. No official pixel spec found.

照片中人士由下顎至頭頂的尺寸應為32毫米至36毫米，頭頂上須保留適當空位。

HK.open_questions: ImmD does not explicitly mention phone selfies; self_photo=true rests on its acceptance of uploaded digital-camera images. Kiosk photo service is optional, so applicants otherwise supply the photo.

avere una larghezza di 35–40mm

IT.open_questions: 'Alla fronte' (to the forehead) is ambiguous between hairline and top of head. The official leaflet/GU 2009 annex gives width 35-40 mm and 'sfondo chiaro', the web page 35x45 and white. No official text explicitly addresses home photos.

JP.open_questions: MOFA's notice PDF (100171389.pdf) could not be opened, so 'pale blue still accepted' is not confirmed in 2025 wording; light blue/grey rest on Kagawa's 'plain pale colour' text. Gunma warns self-taken photos may fail the spec. No eye-line rule.

NL.name: Netherlands

evidence.quote: Vast formaat: 35 mm x 45 mm (breedte x hoogte).
Vanaf 11 jaar: van kin tot kruin minimaal 26 mm en maximaal 30 mm.
Alleen bij personen met een grote haardos kan het voorkomen dat de haardos niet geheel afgebeeld wordt.
lichtgrijs, lichtblauw of wit; egaal; éénkleurig; geen kleurverloop

afgedrukt op hoogwaardig, glad fotopapier; minimaal 400 dpi resolutie

NL.open_questions: 'Kruin' (crown) is not defined in words; the Fotomatrix 2020 diagram puts the top of short hair at the 30 mm line. No official text explicitly addresses home-taken photos; only print quality is required.

NZ.name: New Zealand

evidence.quote: be standard size 35mm x 45mm.
Head, including hair, must be 80% of image height.
The background must be plain and light, but not white.
Pale blues, greys and creams work better than white.
900–4500 pixels wide and 1200–6000 pixels high
You can wear prescription glasses in your photo if they are not tinted or thick-framed.
You can use a professional passport photo service or take a photo with your own device.
Get someone else to take your photo Selfies will be rejected.

NZ.open_questions: 80% is stated as a single value (converted 0.8 x 45 = 36 mm); the allowed tolerance is not stated. The printed-photo spec comes from the PAS300 paper renewal form (updated 13 Aug 2026); the web page gives only digital specs.

PL.name: Poland

zdjęcie powinno przedstawiać całą głowę (od jej czubka) oraz górną część barków, twarz powinna zajmować 70-80% zdjęcia

wykonane na błyszczącym papierze fotograficznym lub błyszczącym papierze fotograficznym przeznaczonym do drukarek

PL.open_questions: Background: gov.pl page says white; MSWiA template recommends white or light grey; statute (via uw-pomorski) says plain light. No adult pixel spec (adults apply in person with a print). Self-photo is not addressed explicitly; no photographer requirement exists and printer photo paper is allowed.

Spectacles must have clear and untinted lenses where the eyes are clearly visible

A passport-sized, digital, colour photograph taken within the last 3 months

SG.open_questions: ICA's own pages (updated 30 Oct 2026) give no mm sizes; the size and head values come from the Singapore High Commission New Delhi page (MFA, updated 6 Nov 2025). ICA's 'white background' rule is shown in an image, not in page text.

from the bottom of the chin to the crown (the top of the head, not the top of the hair).
be taken against a plain cream or light grey background
shows a plain, uniform, light grey or cream background (5% to 10% grey is recommended)
at least 600 pixels wide and 750 pixels tall

GB.open_questions: Photographer guidance is dated 9 April 2014 but still published on gov.uk; it says glasses should be removed, stricter than the public page.

US.name: United States

evidence.quote: Attach one photo, 2x2 inches in size.
Head must be 1-1 3/8 inches from the bottom of the chin to the top of the head
measured from the top of the head (not the hairline or the applicant's hair) to the bottom of the chin (not including facial hair)
Eye height is between 1 1/8 inches to 1 3/8 inches (28 mm – 35 mm) from the bottom of the photo
Use a plain white or off-white background
Eyeglasses are not acceptable unless they cannot be removed for medical reasons
You must not accept a form DS-11 or form DS-82 received without a photograph at the public counter.
If you choose to submit photos printed at home, they must meet the requirements as listed above or they will be rejected.

US.open_questions: travel.state.gov (photo page, online-renewal upload page) is behind a bot check and was not read, so current online-renewal pixel limits are unverified (a 2022 US Embassy Belgium page lists 600-1200 px square). That embassy page also says head 'including hair', which conflicts with the 2024 FAM (hair excluded).
